Disney Reveals Character-Inspired Medals for 2026 Wine & Dine Half Marathon Weekend

Steve Liebman Follow on X Send an email August 25, 2026
Less than a minute
Share
Facebook X LinkedIn Save Reddit WhatsApp Share via Email Print
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

runDisney has unveiled the finisher medals for the upcoming 2026 Disney  Wine & Dine Half Marathon Weekend, scheduled for Oct. 23–25 at Disney World.

MeritPrizes & Contests

This year’s medal designs draw inspiration from global EPCOT World Showcase pavilions alongside iconic Disney characters:

Discover more
Theme Parks
Merit Prizes & Contests
Track & Field

5K: Features Marie, Toulouse, and Berlioz from The Aristocats set against France-themed details of the France pavilion.

10K: Highlights Donald Duck, Panchito, and José Carioca from Los Tres Caballeros on a marigold-shaped plaque celebrating the Mexico pavilion.

Half Marathon: Features Mary Poppins against a London skyline with an umbrella topper and penguin details honoring the United Kingdom.

Running& Walking

Two Course Challenge: A locket-style medal starring Grumpy and Snow White, complete with German village details.
